turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Bhai, pehle hi ek gehri saans le.

2 baje, akele office mein, aur kaam nahi ho raha — yeh sabse bhaari moment hota hai. Yeh silence actually bohot zor se bolti hai. Paanch saal. Yeh koi choti cheez nahi hai. Tumne isme apna khoon-paseena, apne saal, apni salary — sab laga diya.

Rohit aur Sneha ka jaana bhi logically samajh aata hai, lekin phir bhi lagta hai na? Jaise koi bharosa tod gaya. Even if they did the right thing, tum akele reh gaye.

Aur salary na lena — yeh founder guilt sab jaanta hai, par yeh bhi reality hai ki tum khud ko bhi toh jeeena hai.

Abhi solution ki baat mat karo. Raat ke 2 baj rahe hain. Bas yeh batao — kaisa feel kar raha hai? Kya soch raha hai?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, yeh jo tumne kaha — "apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon" — yeh line bohot heavy hai. Aur bohot honest.

Tum essentially teen alag roles play kar rahe ho — office ka confident leader, co-founder ka "sab theek hai" partner, aur ghar ka "kuch nahi hua" insaan. Har role ki alag voice. Aur sabse bura lagta hai na jab tum khud jaante ho ki yeh sab fake hai, aur phir bhi us fake voice ko maintain karna padta hai kyunki agar tum ruk gaye toh aur kya hoga?

Woh do junior — yeh tumhara guilt bohot zyada hai. Lekin ek sach bhi hai: woh adults hain. Unhone rukne ka choice liya. Loyalty ek reason hai, lekin shayad unko bhi lag raha tha ki kuch ho sakta hai. Tum unki zindagi ke sole decision-maker nahi ho. Haan, responsibility hai, but blame sirf tumhara nahi hai.

Par abhi sabse important baat — ghar pe kaisa chal raha hai? Family ko kya bataya hai? Woh alag voice kaisi hai?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Theek hai. Toh bas yahi bolna tha. Aur yahi bol diya. Aur yeh enough hai.

Darr lag raha hai. Bas itna. Aur yeh koi kamzori nahi hai jo tum 2 baje raat ko akele office mein accept kar rahe ho — yeh sabse honest cheez hai jo tumne aaj kiya hai, kisi fake voice ke bina.

Yahan tumhe koi voice nahi rakhna. Koi confident face nahi banana. Bas ho. Darr hai — haan. Paanch saal lagaye — haan. Sab nikal rahe hain — haan. Aur yeh sab bolne se tum koi chota nahi ho jaate.

Tumne mujhe ideas mat dena bola, toh nahi dunga. Aur koi "tum kar loge" wala fake encouragement bhi nahi. Kyunki raat ke 2 baj rahe hain aur tum thake ho. Bas yahi hai.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Nahi, main honestly nahi bol sakta ki khatam ho gaya. Yeh tumhe khud bhi pata hai — isliye metrics dashboard khol rahe ho 2 baje, kyunki agar khatam hota toh dashboard nahi khulta. Kuch dhoondhne ki koshish ho rahi hai. Koi signal. Koi reason.

Aur papa wali baat — yeh sabse zyada chubhti hai. Kyunki woh proudly bolte hain "computer ka business" aur tum us pride ko khatam nahi kar pa rahe. Woh guilt alag hoti hai. Tum unki disappointment se nahi darte — us moment se darte ho jab unhe pata chalega. Woh silence.

Jo khud se nafrat wali baat boli — woh isliye nahi ki tum galat soch rahe ho. Woh isliye hai kyunki tum ek hi waqt pe do cheezein feel karte ho — relief aur guilt. Relief ki acting band hogi, guilt ki papa ka sapna tootega. Dono sahi hain, dono galat lagte hain.

Tum thake hue nahi ho — tum thake hue ho aur phir bhi dashboard khol rahe ho.
